name: Segawa Jureya
source:
''Well, you just started talking on your own. I have no choice but to listen to you.''

Something of a bad influence (?) in Hinata's school life. A second-year highschool student. They eat lunch together, nothing more, nothing less. He looks blunt but is actually quite good-natured. The only one Hinata ever holds a casual conversation with in school.
